reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining OneCoin through claims of profit and an "unlimited revenue generating program," while directing participants to grow a team and business. The description explicitly invites viewers to contact the promoter to join the "largest team build," making recruitment central to the earning opportunity rather than presenting neutral cryptocurrency education.

citations.quote: position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program
provide all support you need to grow your team and business
Contact Tom at: [EMAIL] to join the largest team build
how to make a profit from the cryptocurrency

opening.argument: Judge, distinguish an invitation from a guaranteed return. The narrator asks viewers to "Imagine having the opportunity" and describes "huge growth potential in the market"; those are prospective claims, not a stated payout rate or a promise that every participant will earn money. The presentation promotes "training and marketing tools" and an "educational product." It does not give an explicit risk warning, but its promotional language should not be treated as proof of a guaranteed-return scheme.

citations.quote: Imagine having the opportunity
huge growth potential in the market
Our training and marketing tools combined with a solid and strong educational product

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited "unlimited revenue generating program" is troubling language, but it does not specify a payout, a required payment, or compensation for recruiting another person. Likewise, support to "grow your team and business" can describe ordinary business development. The contact invitation establishes solicitation, not the terms of an abusive compensation structure.

citations.quote: position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program
provide all support you need to grow your team and business
Contact Tom at: [EMAIL] to join the largest team build

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional phrasing about market potential does not neutralize the direct earnings pitch. The narrator offers to "position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program," promises support to "grow your team and business," and the description asks viewers to join a "team build." The defense's cited educational product does not explain why recruitment is so prominent in the proposed earning opportunity.

citations.quote: position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program
provide all support you need to grow your team and business
to join the largest team build

opening.argument: Judge, the video also presents an instructional subject. Its title asks "What is One Coin?" The narration explains that Bitcoin's idea "was to digitally replicate gold" and discusses why "a decentralized currency is important." Later it says it will "teach how to profit from the cryptocurrency" and identifies an "educational product." Read as a whole, this can be understood as cryptocurrency and business training, even though the presentation encourages participation.

citations.quote: What is One Coin?
the idea behind bitcoins, was to digitally replicate gold
The idea of a decentralized currency is important
we will not only teach how to profit from the cryptocurrency
a solid and strong educational product

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the invitation to join a team as the video's entire purpose. Yet the narration also introduces a cryptocurrency concept and explicitly offers teaching. The description's contact line supports a promotional reading, but does not erase that instructional material or show that the teaching is merely a pretext.

citations.quote: The idea of a decentralized currency is important because it removes those levers of power that people can exploit to corrupt.
we will not only teach how to profit from the cryptocurrency
Contact Tom at: [EMAIL] to join the largest team build

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The brief explanation of Bitcoin does not make instruction the central offer. The narrator immediately couples teaching with an "unlimited revenue generating program" and says participants will receive support to "grow your team and business." The description supplies a direct invitation to join a team. The educational language therefore sits inside a recruitment-oriented earnings pitch.

citations.quote: we will not only teach how to profit from the cryptocurrency but also how to position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program
provide all support you need to grow your team and business
to join the largest team build

opening.argument: Judge, this is plainly a commercial promotion, but promotion alone does not establish a scam mechanism. The narrator identifies "training and marketing tools," an "educational product," and a "payment plan"; the description provides a contact address for joining a team. Those details fit an offer of business services and participation. They do not state that viewers must buy a mining package, surrender credentials, or earn commissions from people they recruit. The evidence warrants scrutiny of the offer, not a conclusion that the missing transaction terms are deceptive.

citations.quote: Our training and marketing tools combined with a solid and strong educational product, enhanced by an outstanding and simple payment plan
Contact Tom at: [EMAIL] to join the largest team build

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution connects "how to make a profit" with "grow your team and business," but the quoted words never say profit is paid for recruiting team members. A "team build" may be part of ordinary sales organization. Without the compensation terms, the opening identifies an aggressive pitch, not the claimed recruitment-commission mechanism.

citations.quote: how to make a profit from the cryptocurrency
provide all support you need to grow your team and business
to join the largest team build

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The defense is right that the exact commission schedule is not supplied, but its ordinary-commerce reading leaves out how the offer is framed. The video combines an "unlimited revenue generating program" with support to "grow your team and business," while the description invites viewers to join the "largest team build." Those linked claims make recruitment central to the promoted earning opportunity, even without a displayed payout table.
